description: Give a team role to somebody on the board, as its administrator: held at once, never asked for a yes — giving a role somebody asked for IS the yes, and tells them. Giving it twice keeps their place in the order. Issues for the role with nobody on them reach its holder of longest standing. The board's owner and its administrators only; the person must be on the board.

role.description: The role, by name or id.

who.description: The person: their username or e-mail, 'me', or by Telegram — 'tg:<numeric id>' or '@handle' as their account carries it from a Telegram sign-in. Somebody named by Telegram who is not on the board is not found.

name: give_team_role
title: Give team role
